name: Navigating The Rift
source:
Planning to propose to your girlfriend of 5 years, the two of you take a romantic tour of the galaxy only for disaster to strike. Saved at the last moment, you are left isolated on a huge research vessel in a forgotten corner of space. 
Your rescuer - an amoral man gone insane from prolonged isolation - will stop at nothing to drag your girlfriend into a sexual relationship.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/TrippyDippity]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
两人计划向相恋五年的女友求婚，踏上浪漫的银河之旅，却遭遇灾难。在最后一刻获救的你被孤立在一艘巨大的研究船上，位于太空中一个被遗忘的角落。
你的救援者——一个因长期孤立而变得疯狂的不道德的男人——会不择手段地把你的女朋友拖入性关系。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/c/TrippyDippity]Patreon[/url]]
